headline: S.P. Apparels sets record date for stock split
hook: Record date set for December split
summary: S.P. Apparels Limited has informed the stock exchanges that December 10, 2026, will serve as the record date for its upcoming stock split and subdivision. Existing shareholders as of this date will be eligible for the corporate action. Such moves generally aim to improve liquidity in the stock by reducing the share price denomination. Indian retail investors holding the stock ahead of this date will receive subdivided shares.
why_it_matters: Holders as of December 10 receive subdivided shares.

headline: S.P. Apparels reports outcome of board meeting
hook: Routine governance update from S.P. Apparels
summary: S.P. Apparels Limited has informed the stock exchanges regarding the outcome of its board meeting held on October 6, 2026. Procedural filings of this nature are standard corporate updates with no immediate operational impact. Retail investors holding the stock should check exchange filings for specific corporate actions if any were approved.
why_it_matters: No direct financial impact for retail shareholders.
